title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering a matrix involves adjusting each column to have a mean of zero, except for the intercept column. This can affect the coefficients in a linear regression model. Consider how this might influence the comparison between $$MSE_A$$ and $$MSE_B$$.

title: Exploring Regularization
text: Regularization adds a penalty to the loss function to prevent overfitting. In this problem, we are using a fixed lambda value. Think about how regularization might impact the training MSE for different models.

title: Comparing MSEs
text: Consider the effect of mean-centering on the variance of the data. How might this influence the training MSE when comparing two models?
